# skillissue.sh

> Jack Arturo's personal/agent skills. Packages on GitHub; install with AutoVault.

## Site
- Home: https://skillissue.sh/
- Catalog: https://skillissue.sh/skills/
- Machine catalog: https://skillissue.sh/skills.json
- Source packages: https://github.com/jack-arturo/skillissue/tree/main/skills
- Install pin (this build): b92ee27006911c687b8d0a6c43231aad149cda6c

## Install
```
autovault add jack-arturo/skillissue@b92ee27006911c687b8d0a6c43231aad149cda6c:skills/<name>/SKILL.md --sync-profiles
```

## Public skills (32)
- long-haul-parallel-repair (v1.0.0) — Agents would either under-delegate or fan out without authorization. This skill is the contract for when "work for hours" is real.
- session-consolidate (v1.1.0) — Sessions produced gold that evaporated. Consolidate is the checkpoint: memory pass + skill pass with human veto on destructive skill changes.
- skill-author (v2.0.0) — Half-finished SKILL.md files were rotting in chat. This is the admission checklist before something enters the vault.
- autojack-delegate (v1.0.0) — Claude Code sessions hit capability walls. Delegate instead of inventing half-MCP stacks.
- automem (v1.0.0) — Memory only works if every agent uses the same ritual. This skill is that ritual for Grok/Claude/Codex hosts.
- autovault-skill (v1.1.0) — Agents kept looking for MCP when the skill was already symlinked. This meta-skill explains the model.
- entity-dossier (v0.1.0) — Pre-meeting context kept dying with the chat. The dossier in AutoMem is the deliverable.
- cloudflare-lead-capture (v1.4.0) — Hat Trick / waitlist work kept being rewritten. Packaged as scaffold + doctor + setup.
- cloudflare-ops (v1.0.5) — Every AutoHub-adjacent deploy was re-discovering the same wrangler gotchas. This skill is the operator runbook: one canonical deploy path, preview D1 isolation, no split-brain…
- cloudflare-commerce-deploy (v1.0.3) — Commerce launches need DNS, secrets, and preview/prod isolation — not ad-hoc wrangler folklore.
- cloudflare-emdash-cms-deploy (v1.12.0) — Pages-shaped deploys were serving raw source after Astro 6. This skill owns the Workers recipe and binding gotchas.
- pirsch-analytics-bootstrap (v1.1.0) — Analytics installs were inconsistent and sometimes created domains without asking.
- babysit (v1.2.0) — PR review loops were eating whole sessions. Babysit is the exclusive-label workflow: active, waiting-codex, waiting-ci, blocked, ready.
- codex-review (v2.0.1) — People still say "codex review." Route to babysit without a second workflow.
- commit-message (v1.0.0) — Commit messages were either empty or novels. This drafts from the staged diff.
- browser-hand (v0.6.1) — Drive your real logged-in Chrome from an agent — extension bridge, no remote debugging port on the default profile, background-first so focus stays with you.
- dev-browser (v0.6.1) — Superseded by browser-hand for real logged-in Chrome. Kept for historical install links; prefer browser-hand.
- voiceink-2-upgrade (v1.0.0) — Field notes for surviving VoiceInk 2.0: Parakeet V3 Modes, the Apple Speech trap, prompt=<none> enhancement failures, Dictionary emoji/path replacements, and a settings-backup…
- flashspace (v1.0.0) — Workspace switching was voice/chat friction. CLI skill removes the mouse hunt.
- raycast (v1.0.0) — No official Raycast MCP. The skill is file-native + deeplink operations.
- awtrix-board (v1.0.0) — Desk presence without phone spam. Device-direct HTTP, no HA required for basic ops.
- home-assistant-operator (v1.0.0) — HA access was tribal knowledge. Skill owns inventory, verify, maintain.
- inbox-triage (v1.1.0) — Unread was a tax. Four labels, parallel classify, single digest.
- resend-cli (v2.3.2) — Email setup needed a vendor CLI skill with non-interactive agent flags.
- triage-autohub-runtime (v1.0.1) — Retry storms looked like many bugs. This skill separates root cause from cascade.
- mcp-builder (v1.0.0) — We kept shipping 1:1 API wrappers that rotted in agent context. This skill encodes the resist-bloat rules Jack runs house-wide.
- mcp-registry-maintainer (v1.0.0) — MCP server sprawl without inventory. Maintain registry scans and health.
- jacks-writing-style (v1.0.0) — Every public surface under my name was drifting into assistant-voice: hedged, bland, "it's worth noting." This skill is the fix — examples from real READMEs, blogs, and changelogs.
- docs-screenshot-packager (v1.0.0) — Screenshot PRs stalled with local-only images and placeholders. This is the full pack pipeline.
- html-asset-renderer (v1.0.0) — Design exports needed dimension-checked production assets, not freehand screenshots.
- cli-installer-ux (v1.0.0) — Install scripts leaked machine output into user-facing copy. This skill is the UX gate.
- release-readiness (v1.0.0) — Tags shipped without Stable tag alignment. This is the preflight.
